nodes.label: Base Distribution (plugins/base/)
nodes.rationale: The base distribution is the visible app: 14 plugins that ship with the server, individually replaceable and holding no privilege the kernel does not give every plugin. This is the reference for writing a plugin.

nodes.label: Microkernel Architecture
nodes.rationale: The microkernel principle: if the base distribution needed a special case anywhere in the kernel, the kernel would be wrong. The kernel knows one domain model (a document is text) and extension-point names are opaque strings.

nodes.label: Plugin Dependency Graph
nodes.rationale: The loader's activation order is precisely a topological order of the dependency graph. A dependency always activates first; a failed dependency skips its whole subtree.
